name: Kühtaier Schlössl
beschreibung: The Kühtaier Schlössl is a hotel in Silz in the Ötztal in Österreich. The location in the Tiroler Alpen offers a close-to-nature environment. The amenities include comfortable rooms and a wellness area. The quiet atmosphere is ideal for relaxation. The traditional furnishings create a cozy ambience. The target group is relaxation seekers and nature lovers. Couples and families are also addressed.
